Reicon upstream icon credits

Source: https://github.com/dqev/reicon

Reicon states that its base icons are built using elements from:

- Solar Icons, designed by 480 Design, licensed under CC BY 4.0; the package
  referenced by Reicon is maintained by Saoudi H. under the MIT License.
  https://solar-icons.vercel.app/
  https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
- Zappicon, licensed under the Zappicon License.
  https://zappicon.com/
  https://zappicon.com/license

CordisX uses selected Reicon glyph modules as its default Host icon provider.
These icons remain upstream assets and are not represented as CordisX-owned
MIT icon assets. CordisX does not export the raw Reicon SVG/icon dataset or act
as an icon-library redistribution channel.
